title: Reckoner header
description: A quiet header for a dark band: wordmark left, and on desktop a faintly lifted tray at the right holding three semibold links with tiny chevrons and a solid linen button. Links tint camel over half a second on hover and open small dropdowns. On phones it stays fixed on merlot with a 40px menu square that opens a full-height panel of 22px links.
notes: always dark (wraps itself in .dark); pair it with reckoner-hero, which it floats over
fixed on phones, absolute from lg up (scrolls away with the hero, as the original does)
needs JavaScript for the phone menu (hydrate: load); dropdowns are CSS only
